title: 25 Centavos

obverse.description: Cuban coat of arms, date below, circular legends: name of the country above, and face value in words below; with 8-sided ring on edge.
obverse.lettering_translation:
Republic of Cuba
2018
twenty five centavos

reverse.description: A street in Trinidad, traditional houses and the Church of San Francisco de Asis, face value as numerals on upper right, name of the town on center left.

comments:
IMPORTANT NOTE: After an investigation, it was not possible to confirm the existence of coins with years 2009 and 2016.
On Krause catalog the coins are not listed, nor on other three Cuban catalogs checked.
Therefore, if you think you have one of these, please check carefully and correct your listing if is mistakenly registered, or please send picture of the coin to referee, if you really have it.

1994, minted at Canada: out of the most noticeable difference: medal rotation vs. coin rotation on the other years, there are design variations:
On obverse, shield has variations and fonts are slightly different; on reverse, Church and houses drawing have differences.




Normal and Narrow date 2003
(source image: Chiefa Coins)


Bold and thin date 2006

Difference on year font 2000/2008

The city of Trinidad (Trinity) is located on center of the country, is the capital of Sancti Spiritus municipe, in same name province, and was the 3rd. town founded by Spain in Cuba, about 1514.
Trinidad and Valle de los Ingenios (near Trinidad) were declared humanity patrimony by UNESCO, owing to their abundance of colonial buildings, and specially for its excellent conservation state.


Trinidad historical downtown.


Manaca-Iznaga Tower, Valle de los Ingenios.

Known variations on year issues:
1994: Medal rotation instead of coin as on the rest years, differences on both faces.
2000: Thick small straight date.
2003: Normal date.
 Narrow date.
2006: Thin round straight date.
 Thick round straight date.
2007: Thin sharp straight date.
2008: Thin round curved date (small).
2018: Thin straight date.
